title: Your backstage pass to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is waiting
originalTitle: Your backstage pass to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is waiting
content:
7:02 AM PDT · July 23, 2026

Volunteering at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 isn’t just about scoring free admission (though a free three-day pass is a pretty sweet perk). It’s your chance to get a behind-the-scenes look at how one of the world’s biggest startup conferences gets built — and to connect with the people shaping the future of tech while you’re doing it.

Whether you’re an aspiring founder looking to understand how world-class events operate, an event enthusiast wanting hands-on experience, or someone hungry for inspiration and connections, volunteering at Disrupt 2026 is your all-access pass to see how the magic happens.

TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 hits Moscone West in San Francisco this October 13–15, and we’d love to have you on the team. Learn more. 

What you’ll get 

As a volunteer, you’ll help bring the show to life — and in return, you’ll get:

  • Free general admission for all three days of Disrupt 2026 (October 13–15).
  • Hands-on experience producing one of the top startup events of the year. 
  • Direct connections with fellow volunteers and the Disrupt community. 
  • A front-row seat to pitches, announcements, and the newest breakthroughs in tech. 

This is more than a ticket — it’s a foot in the door to the startup ecosystem.

Here’s what we need 

To volunteer at Disrupt 2026, you’ll need to: 

  • Commit to at least 12 hours of volunteering before and during the conference days.
  • Attend a mandatory in-person orientation on Monday, October 12 (afternoon).
  • Be 18 years or older.

Local applicants are preferred, but we welcome people from anywhere. Spots are limited, so don’t wait. Application closes on September 25th.

Apply now!
